card.summary: no service and no account; "an open-source implementation of Cloudflare's Warp, enhanced with Psiphon integration"

free_tier.stated: no service and no account; "an open-source implementation of Cloudflare's Warp, enhanced with Psiphon integration"

egress.terms: not stated by this tool; the traffic reaches Cloudflare WARP and Psiphon, neither of which it prices; ingress: none

record.chaining: feeds a SOCKS5 consumer, so it composes with a proxy-aware client rather than with a router.
record.binding_note: the tool adds no quota of its own; the WARP record carries the allowance

identity_cost.detail: no account; WARP registration is created by the tool

record.reliability_note: SOCKS5 in, not a tunnel interface; behaviour depends on Cloudflare and Psiphon endpoints the tool does not control
record.confidence_note: a probe through the SOCKS5 listener would raise it

evidence.proved: the feature list: Warp integration, Psiphon chaining, warp-in-warp, SOCKS5 proxy
the -b flag: "socks bind address (default: 127.0.0.1:8086)"; no .conf output
release v1.2.6 published 2025-06-04; last push 2025-12-15; 1975 stars

record.notes: Its unique feature is chaining WARP through Psiphon, which reaches a different exit than WARP alone. Maintenance is slower than wgcf: one release in the last 18 months.

extras.wg_detail: it registers its own WARP identity and exposes a local SOCKS5 listener (default 127.0.0.1:8086) rather than emitting a .conf
extras.volume_stated: not stated by this tool; the traffic reaches Cloudflare WARP and Psiphon, neither of which it prices
extras.transit_note: through Cloudflare WARP, optionally then Psiphon
extras.hosting_requirement: none; runs on the device, exposes SOCKS5 only
